{"effort": "high", "extra": {}, "messages": [["user", "## Scenario

Preferential trade agreement origin claims, duty forgone, and customs compliance verifications across major entry ports, 2022–2023

The national customs administration maintains this registry of monthly preferential tariff filings to monitor revenue forgone under free trade agreements, evaluate origin certification compliance across tariff headings, and track claims through clearance and audit stages.

## Columns

| Column | Kind | Declared as |
|---|---|---|
| `clearance_stage` | category | Filing Lodged, Customs Review, Origin Verification, Final Liquidation; ordered=stage; group workflow |
| `customs_value` | measure | unit thousand USD; additive |
| `declaration_month` | time | 2022-01-01 to 2023-12-01, monthly; group calendar |
| `disallowed_amount` | measure | unit thousand USD; additive |
| `duty_forgone` | measure | unit thousand USD; additive |
| `effective_preference_pct` | measure | unit percent; non-additive |
| `port_of_entry` | category | Detroit, Buffalo, Laredo, El Paso, Los Angeles, Long Beach, New York/Newark, Savannah; within port_region; group geography |
| `port_region` | category | Northern Border, Southern Border, Pacific Gateway, Atlantic Gateway; group geography |
| `trade_programme` | category | USMCA, CAFTA-DR, KORUS FTA, GSP Beneficiary; group agreement |

## Figures

- `f01`
    p0: bar, grouped by trade_programme, SUM(duty_forgone), unit thousand USD
    p0 reads trade_programme off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: Total duty forgone compared across different preferential trade programmes
- `f02`
    p0: line, grouped by declaration_month, SUM(customs_value), unit thousand USD
    p0 reads declaration_month off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: Monthly trend in total entered customs value claiming tariff preferences
- `f03`
    p0: funnel, grouped by clearance_stage, COUNT(*)
    p0 reads clearance_stage off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: Progression and volume drop-off of preference claims across customs clearance stages
- `f04`
    p0: scatter, grouped by nothing, NONE(customs_value, duty_forgone), unit thousand USD
    drawn to answer: Relationship between declared customs value and the duty forgone amount
- `f05`
    p0: bar, grouped by trade_programme, SUM(duty_forgone), unit thousand USD
    p0 reads trade_programme off the axis tick
    p1: grouped_bar, grouped by trade_programme, port_region, SUM(duty_forgone), unit thousand USD
    p1 reads trade_programme off the axis tick, port_region off the legend
    the panels are related by: drilldown
- `f06`
    p0-p1 each: bar, grouped by trade_programme, SUM(duty_forgone), unit thousand USD
    p0-p1 each reads trade_programme off the axis tick
    p0 is titled '2022-01-01 to 2022-12-16'
    p1 is titled '2022-12-17 to 2023-12-01'
    the panels are related by: time_split
- `f07`
    p0: bar, grouped by trade_programme, SUM(duty_forgone), unit thousand USD
    p0 reads trade_programme off the axis tick
    p1: bar, grouped by trade_programme, SUM(customs_value), unit thousand USD
    p1 reads trade_programme off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: dual_metric
- `f08`
    p0: bar, grouped by trade_programme, SUM(duty_forgone), unit thousand USD, labelled 'SUM'
    p0 reads trade_programme off the axis tick
    p0: error_bar, grouped by trade_programme, FIVE_NUM(duty_forgone), unit thousand USD, labelled 'spread'
    p0 reads trade_programme off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_range
- `f09`
    p0: bar, grouped by trade_programme, SUM(duty_forgone), unit thousand USD, labelled 'SUM(duty_forgone) [thousand USD]'
    p0 reads trade_programme off the axis tick
    p0: category_line, grouped by trade_programme, SUM(customs_value), unit thousand USD, labelled 'SUM(customs_value) [thousand USD]'
    p0 reads trade_programme off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_metric
- `f10`
    p0: bar, grouped by trade_programme, SUM(duty_forgone), unit thousand USD, labelled '2022-01-01 to 2022-12-16'
    p0 reads trade_programme off the axis tick
    p0: category_line, grouped by trade_programme, SUM(duty_forgone), unit thousand USD, labelled '2022-12-17 to 2023-12-01'
    p0 reads trade_programme off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_slice
- `f11`
    p0: bar, grouped by trade_programme, SUM(duty_forgone), unit thousand USD
    p0 reads trade_programme off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: drilldown
- `f12`
    p0: grouped_bar, grouped by trade_programme, port_region, SUM(duty_forgone), unit thousand USD
    p0 reads trade_programme off the axis tick, port_region off the legend
    the panels are related by: drilldown
- `f13`
    p0: stacked_bar, grouped by clearance_stage, trade_programme, MAX(duty_forgone), unit thousand USD
    p0 reads clearance_stage off the axis tick, trade_programme off the legend
- `f14`
    p0: table_chart, grouped by port_of_entry, trade_programme, AVG(disallowed_amount), unit thousand USD
    p0 reads port_of_entry off the inline label, trade_programme off the inline label
- `f15`
    p0: grouped_bar, grouped by port_region, trade_programme, COUNT(*)
    p0 reads port_region off the axis tick, trade_programme off the legend
- `f16`
    p0: windsock, grouped by declaration_month, FIVE_NUM(effective_preference_pct), unit percent
    p0 reads declaration_month off the axis tick

## What to write

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| `title` | What the figure shows. Name the quantity and how it is broken down |
| `subtitle` | The qualifier: what each mark covers, over what period |
| `unit` | The unit the values are in, as it would be written on an axis |
| `column_names` | One readable name per column below, used on axes and in legends |
